cases.rationale: Untrusted HTML passed to jQuery DOM manipulation methods can execute attacker-controlled script in the page context.
MOVEit Transfer contains a SQL injection vulnerability that permits unauthorized access to its database.
A malicious same-parent-domain page can make authenticated Argo CD API requests on the victim's behalf.
Attacker-controlled Exchange backend-routing cookie values coerce the server into unintended backend requests.

Broken path normalization lets crafted URLs map outside configured directories. The resulting file disclosure is a consequence of path traversal and does not match the hierarchy's misconfiguration-specific InformationExposure label.
Bash executes attacker-supplied trailing shell commands embedded in environment-variable function definitions.
An exposed PHPUnit endpoint evaluates attacker-supplied PHP source from the HTTP request body.
The Struts REST plugin deserializes attacker-controlled XML with XStream without type filtering.
Crafted DNS responses trigger stack-based buffer overflows in glibc resolver functions.
Malformed TLS heartbeat packets cause OpenSSL to read beyond the intended buffer and return process memory.
Chrome identified the underlying FileReader memory-safety defect specifically as a use-after-free.

Failure to enforce authorization lets an unauthenticated attacker reset Confluence and create an administrator account. ImproperAuthorization is the most specific supported node; its CSRF child does not apply.
Rapidly resetting an unbounded sequence of HTTP/2 streams consumes server work and causes denial of service.

The file-upload component accepts arbitrary unauthenticated uploads. This is improper validation of external input, while none of InputValidation's more specific children describes unrestricted file upload.
